name: Arctium lappa root extract
description: Arctium lappa root extract (CAS 84012-13-5 ), commonly known as burdock root extract, is a botanical ingredient sourced from the root of the Arctium lappa plant. It functions as an antioxidant, moisturizing agent, and flavoring component across personal care, food, and pharmaceutical applications. In cosmetic formulations, it is incorporated into scalp treatments, facial serums, and cleansing products where its antioxidant and humectant properties support skin and hair care positioning. Food and beverage manufacturers use burdock root extract as a natural flavoring. This ingredient is utilized in teas, functional drinks, and health food products. Nutraceutical and supplement formulators include it in capsules and liquid preparations targeting wellness and nutritional support for various consumer demographics. Pharmaceutical and herbal product developers source it as a botanical active for inclusion in standardized herbal preparations and OTC topical formulations. The extract is valued for its versatility and historical use in traditional medicine systems. Arctium lappa root extract is supplied as a liquid extract, dry powder, or spray-dried powder, with water, glycerin, or ethanol serving as common carrier bases for liquid forms. These formats allow for easy integration into diverse manufacturing processes. Standard grades include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications, with some suppliers offering standardized extracts defined by inulin or polyphenol content. Quality control ensures consistency across different production batches and applications. Bulk quantities are available for industrial procurement alongside smaller quantities for formulation development. Suppliers ensure that the product meets necessary safety and regulatory requirements for global distribution and use in various industries.
